label: Прямо
description: A 10-sentence usage card for прямо (straight, directly).

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Direction of travel. 'Прямо' means straight ahead and modifies the imperative 'идите', marking the line of motion. It is the core word for giving walking directions.
Strategic focus: Straight movement. 'Прямо' modifies 'едет' to show the car moving in a straight line. The adverb fixes the direction, while 'по дороге' names the surface of travel.
Strategic focus: Direct gaze. 'Прямо' modifies 'смотри' to mean looking directly, without turning aside. It intensifies the directness of the eye contact in this firm imperative.
Strategic focus: Right at a spot. 'Прямо' here means right or just, intensifying the location 'за углом'. In this use it sharpens the precision of where the house is.
Strategic focus: Step-by-step directions. 'Прямо' modifies 'иди' to mark the first straight stretch before a turn. It is the natural opener in a chain of route instructions.
Strategic focus: Speaking frankly. 'Прямо' modifies 'скажи' to mean directly or bluntly, with no evasion. This figurative sense extends the straight-line image to honest speech.
Strategic focus: Direct outlook. 'Прямо' modifies 'выходит' to show the window facing straight onto the square. The adverb stresses an unobstructed, direct orientation.
Strategic focus: Straight trajectory. 'Прямо' modifies 'полетел' to mark a direct flight path. With 'в ворота' it shows the ball heading straight into the goal.
Strategic focus: Right by a place. 'Прямо' here means right, intensifying the location 'у окна'. It tells exactly where to put the chair, close against the window.

missions.phrase: Как мне пройти прямо к вокзалу?
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Asking for a direct route. 'Прямо' modifies 'пройти' to ask for the straight way to the station. In this question it requests a direct path toward the goal.
